does.text: Only queue. LearnSpell appends a request (a 16-byte guid, which source granted it, plus a spell-name FixedString) to a per-entity list in the system's own table; RemoveLearnedSpells just records the entity in a removal set. No component is touched at call time.

does.text: For each entity that has queued learn requests, if the entity is alive and already has eoc::spell::LearnedSpellsComponent, each request's spell is checked against the spell prototype manager (it must be a known spell and IsSpellLearnable); each accepted spell is inserted into the component's per-source list (the guid keys the source) and the entity is marked dirty for replication. Spells that were added this tick are gathered in a list; when that list is not empty, esv::spell::SpellsLearnedEventOneFrameComponent (0x10 bytes, holding that list) is ADDED to the entity for one frame. The queue is then cleared. Rejected spells only log a message.
